svg.title: A holding rewards its ancestry.
svg.desc: Illustration: Dana holds ten percent of one AVA lane’s eligible balance during an interval allocating three thousand credits. Her gross attribution is three hundred credits. With two earning ancestors and a ten percent commission per ancestor, Dana retains two hundred forty, Bob receives thirty, and Alice receives thirty before optional family sharing. The non-earning protocol root receives nothing. Asset principal is not spent on commissions.

g.text: Each earning ancestor receives a fixed share of the original attribution.
Core allocation before optional family sharing. The protocol root earns nothing.
The AVA principal is not spent on referral commissions.
